title: Survey point register
description: Data-driven survey definition (directive §39). The UI renders from this register; there are no point-by-point duplicated controls.

pointId.description: Unique. Note the register includes non-numeric identifiers such as '7a' (§55) and the pipework point '33' (§50).

sections.description: Section membership (A1/A2/B/C/D). Combined with survey-schedule.json this determines whether the point is DUE in a given month.

measurements.description: Exactly the measurements required at this point. The measurement entry screen renders only these (§28).

appliesToSections.description: Optional. When present the measurement is required only when the survey is being performed for one of these sections.

knownCondition.description: Current known elevated condition / hotspot information permitted for display (§52). PRIOR ROUTINE READINGS ARE NOT STORED HERE and must never be shown to a technician performing the current survey.

map.description: Configuration-driven hit area on an approved map asset (§26). Geometry is NEVER invented — absent geometry means the point is reachable from the Area References list only, and the map overlay reports the asset as outstanding.

subPositions.description: Separately selectable positions within a point (e.g. the Point 33 pipework positions, §50). Supplied by controlled configuration only; the prototype must not synthesise geometry.
